Book a stay

A guesthouse in the hills above Lucca

Stay where the olives grow.

Six rooms in a stone farmhouse, a long table under the pergola, and forty hectares of olives that we pick by hand each November. Twenty minutes from Lucca, and a long way from anywhere.

Book a stay

See the rooms

The house

A farmhouse that has fed itself from its own hill since 1780.

The house was built by a family of olive pressers, and the old press is still in the cellar, under the room that now carries its name. We moved here in 2014 with two children and no idea how to prune a tree.

Twelve years on, breakfast is our own bread, our neighbours’ eggs and figs from the wall by the pool; supper, four nights a week, is at one long table for everyone staying.

Giulia and Tomás

The rooms

Six rooms, no two alike

La Torre

Up the tower’s own stair, with windows on all four sides.

€320

sleeps 2

Il Frantoio

The old olive press room, vaulted, and cool all summer.

€260

sleeps 2 or 3

La Limonaia

The lemon house, opening onto the garden and the pool.

€240

sleeps 2

Il Fienile

The hayloft, under the beams, with a bath by the window.

€220

sleeps 2

La Loggia

Off the loggia, looking west over the valley to the sea.

€200

sleeps 2

Le Stalle

The old stables: two rooms, for a family.

€180

sleeps 4

Prices are a night for the room, with breakfast. Supper at the long table is €45 a head, wine from the hill included.

The year at the house

Spring

March to May

Wild asparagus in the hedges, the first swims, and the hills green for a few weeks.

Summer

June to August

Long days, the pool, and supper outside under the pergola until the swifts go to bed.

Autumn

September to November

The harvest. Pick with us for a morning, and take home a litre of oil from your trees.

Winter

December to February

We close in January and February: the house rests, and so do we.

The harvest weeks are filling up.

From €180 a night, with breakfast. Free to cancel until thirty days before you come.

Book a stay

Casa Albero, Via di Vallebuia 14, 55100 Lucca, Italy
